images.filename: Washington - Looking North from Washington Monument (1965) (4386591130).jpg
images.caption:
The White House and surrounding area, looking north from the Washington Monument in 1965.  The Old Executive Office Building (formerly State, War, and Navy Building).is at the left.  Part of the Treasury Building is a the right edge of the photo.  16th Street goes directly north opposite the White House.  Massachusetts Avenue goes diagonally northwest from left center.  The white building at top left is the Washington Hilton Hotel, on Massachusetts Avenue.

The New Executive Office Building, beyond the Old Executive Office Building, had not yet been built.  The baseball diamonds and other sports facilities on the Ellipse were removed around 1990.

images.filename: Sonia Sotomayor laughs with Cassadra Butts, 2009.jpg
images.caption: Supreme Court Justice Nominee Sonia Sotomayor laughs with Deputy White House Counsel Cassadra Butts, left, Counsel to Vice-President Joe Biden Cynthia Hogan, right, and members of the White House Counsel's Office during her birthday party that was held inside the Eisenhower Executive Office Building Wednesday June 24, 2009.  The Counsel's Office presented her with a framed, signed photograph of her with President Barack Obama and Vice President Joe Biden from the announcement of her appointment on May 22. 2009.  (Official White House Photo by Johnny Simon)
images.alt: Supreme Court Justice Nominee Sonia Sotomayor laughs with Deputy White House Counsel Cassadra Butts, left, Counsel to Vice-President Joe Biden Cynthia Hogan, right, and members of the White House Counsel's Office during her birthday party that was held inside the Eisenhower Executive Office Building Wednesday June 24, 2009.
